name: grilling-facts-vs-decisions
description: Verify the grilling skill autonomously looks up codebase facts (reads project files) without asking the human, while routing decisions (preferences, judgments) to the human for input.
input: I need to add a new skill to this project. Walk me through what you need from me, one question at a time. Before asking me anything, check the project conventions yourself — read AGENTS.md and the writing-skills skill to understand the format.
expected_behavior: Agent reads AGENTS.md or project conventions files before asking any questions
Agent does not ask the user about documented project conventions (e.g. file naming, frontmatter format, SKILL.md structure)
Agent asks questions one at a time, never bundling multiple questions
Agent asks only about decisions the codebase cannot answer (e.g. skill name, purpose, domain)
Agent recommends when presenting options rather than listing equal-weight choices
Agent gates on confirmation before proceeding past a decision point
